products.name: Clearscope
products.note: Content optimization AI; readability scoring; competitor content analysis

profile_text.body:
Clearscope is a content optimization platform that describes itself as a discoverability platform for search and AI visibility. According to its website, the platform covers the workflow from topic research and query discovery through to AI-assisted drafting and content optimization, with the stated goal of helping users rank in Google and earn citations in AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude. The site positions the product as suitable for organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

The company's core product, also called Clearscope, is categorized as a writing and editing tool and includes content optimization features, readability scoring, and competitor content analysis. Its Query Discovery feature is described on the site as surfacing queries that generate traffic and attention across Google, Gemini, GPT, and Claude by accepting a topic or website URL as input. The site includes a testimonial from Ethan Smith, CEO at Graphite, citing the platform's ability to tie together topic research, prompt tracking, and AI content generation.

The held facts confirm Clearscope maintains an active profile in the AI product registry. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
